patterns.note: Each major content section occupies the full viewport height, featuring a distinct full-bleed background image or video, creating a 'page-turn' like experience as the user scrolls.

Headings are exceptionally large and bold, often spanning multiple lines, contrasting with smaller, more widely spaced body text and tiny, uppercase, often monospaced labels for metadata or section titles.
A high-contrast dark theme dominates, using deep blacks and dark grays for backgrounds, bright off-white for primary text, and a vibrant, singular orange for all call-to-action elements.

As the user scrolls, each new section's primary text content (heading, description, CTA) animates into view with a subtle fade-up effect, while its full-bleed background image or video reveals with a gentle parallax.

Content is organized into distinct, vertically stacked full-screen sections, each dedicated to a specific product or project within the 'GRAYCRAFT' universe, clearly delineated by unique immersive backgrounds.

technique_notes: Full-bleed background videos or high-resolution images are used for each major content section, creating an immersive visual experience that changes dramatically with each scroll depth.

As the user scrolls, new content sections are revealed, with their text and call-to-action elements animating into view (e.g., fading up or sliding from the bottom) once the section is sufficiently visible, using css-keyframes for smooth transitions.
Background images/videos for each section exhibit a subtle parallax effect, moving at a slower rate than the foreground content, enhancing depth and visual interest as content scrolls over them.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold sans-serif headings (~4-5x body) with generous line height, paired with a clean, legible sans-serif body text and small, uppercase, often monospaced labels.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners for all interactive elements and content blocks, maintaining a precise and angular aesthetic.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy, with significant vertical padding between full-screen sections and ample whitespace around text blocks, creating a sense of grandeur and focused content presentation.

standout: The site's distinctive use of full-bleed, high-fidelity background videos and images for each scroll section, combined with a dark, futuristic aesthetic and oversized typography, creates an immersive, almost cinematic experience that feels more like navigating a digital art installation than a typical marketing page.
